perks.plain_english_summary: While Exhausted, you recover from it faster and your Scratch Marks fade faster.
activation_requirements: You must be suffering from the Exhausted status effect.
deactivation_conditions: The effects stop when Exhausted ends.
duration: Applies for as long as you are Exhausted.
special_interactions: Ghost Notes does not inflict Exhausted; it only affects an existing Exhausted status.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.

perks.verification_notes: The perk was introduced in 9.2.0 and current live values are stated by DBDVault and the recognised DBD Wiki. No later material live balance change was verified.

perks.name: Hardened
perks.current_effect: After you unlock a Chest and cleanse or bless a Totem, Hardened activates for the rest of the Trial. Whenever you would scream for any reason, the scream is suppressed and the Killer's Aura is revealed to you instead for 3/4/5 seconds.
perks.plain_english_summary: After opening a Chest and interacting with a Totem, your screams are replaced by brief Killer Aura reveals.
activation_requirements: Unlock a Chest.
Cleanse or bless a Totem; both the Chest and Totem conditions must be completed.
deactivation_conditions: The perk remains active for the rest of the Trial after both activation actions.
duration: Perk activation persists for the rest of the Trial.
Each Killer Aura reveal lasts 3/4/5 seconds (Tier I/II/III).
special_interactions: Any event that would make you scream can trigger the effect; the scream is suppressed and replaced with the Killer Aura reveal.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.

perks.verification_notes: The current effect, activation actions, and duration are in the official 8.1.0 launch notes and current reference page. The reveal duration is tiered; the activation state lasts for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Head On
perks.current_effect: After hiding in a Locker for 3 seconds, Head On becomes ready. While not Exhausted and not disabled by Idle Crows, hold Sprint as you exit. If the Killer is within 2.5 metres at the time, they are stunned for 3 seconds. A successful stun makes you Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds. Missing causes a Loud Noise Notification for the Killer.
perks.plain_english_summary: After preparing in a Locker, you can stun a nearby Killer by rushing out, then become Exhausted.
activation_requirements: Hide in a Locker for 3 seconds to ready the perk.
Hold Sprint while exiting the Locker.
The Killer must be within 2.5 metres for the stun to connect.
You must not be Exhausted or disabled by Idle Crows.
deactivation_conditions: A successful stun applies Exhausted, during which Head On cannot be used.
The ready state does not provide a stun if the Killer is outside the 2.5-metre range.
duration: Locker preparation: 3 seconds.
Killer stun: 3 seconds.
Exhausted after successful stun: 60/50/40 seconds (Tier I/II/III).
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: No once-per-Trial limit; Exhausted prevents reuse until it expires. Cannot be used while affected by Idle Crows.
special_interactions: A missed attempt causes a Loud Noise Notification. The 3.7.0 live change added the restriction against use while affected by Idle Crows.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added the restriction that Head On cannot be used while the Survivor has accrued Idle Crows; also clarified the Locker rush and stun-zone behavior.

perks.verification_notes: The cooldown field is null: Exhausted is the post-stun status effect and practical reuse restriction, not a separate perk cooldown. Current DBDVault text confirms the 2.5 m range, 3 s stun, and 3-second Locker preparation. DBDVault attributes the Idle Crows restriction to 3.7.0, but the official 3.1.0 patch notes already state that restriction; official history is used here.

perks.name: Hope
perks.current_effect: Once the Exit Gates are powered, Hope activates and grants you 3/4/5% Haste for the remainder of the Trial.
perks.plain_english_summary: When the Exit Gates are powered, you move faster until the Trial ends.
activation_requirements: The Exit Gates must be powered.
deactivation_conditions: The effect ends when the Trial ends.
duration: Remainder of the Trial after the Exit Gates are powered.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Activates once when the Exit Gates are powered and remains active for the rest of the Trial.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced Haste from 5/6/7% to 3/4/5%; current duration remains the remainder of the Trial.

perks.verification_notes: Current duration is permanent through the remaining Trial; the older 120-second duration is obsolete. Current Haste values were reduced in live patch 9.2.0.

perks.name: Hyperfocus
perks.current_effect: Succeeding a Great Skill Check while repairing or healing grants 1 Token, up to 6. Each Token increases Skill Check trigger odds by 4% and pointer rotation speed by 4%, up to 24% each. Each Token also increases Great Skill Check bonus progression by 10/20/30% of its base value, up to a total bonus of 60/120/180% by tier. All Tokens are lost after succeeding only a Good Skill Check, failing a Skill Check, or having the action interrupted by any means.
perks.plain_english_summary: Consecutive Great Skill Checks while repairing or healing build up to six tokens that increase Skill Check odds, pointer speed, and Great-check progress.
activation_requirements: You must be repairing or healing and succeed a Great Skill Check to gain a Token.
deactivation_conditions: All Tokens are lost if you succeed only a Good Skill Check.
All Tokens are lost if you fail a Skill Check.
All Tokens are lost if the repair or healing action is interrupted by any means.
perks.token_or_stack_behavior: Gain 1 Token per successful Great Skill Check while repairing or healing, up to 6. Tokens increase Skill Check trigger odds and pointer rotation speed by 4% each, and increase Great Skill Check bonus progression by 10/20/30% of its base per token according to tier. All tokens are lost on the listed reset conditions.
special_interactions: Applies to both repairing and healing Skill Checks; interruption of either action resets the accumulated Tokens.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.

perks.verification_notes: Current values agree between DBDVault and the recognised DBD Wiki. No later material live balance change was verified; 10.2.0 PTB does not list this perk.

perks.name: Inner Focus
perks.current_effect: You can always see other Survivors' Scratch Marks. Whenever another Survivor loses a Health State due to the Killer, the Killer's Aura is revealed to you for 6/8/10 seconds, depending on perk tier.
perks.plain_english_summary: It shows teammates' Scratch Marks and briefly reveals the Killer when the Killer causes a teammate to lose a Health State.
activation_requirements: Scratch Mark visibility is continuously available during the Trial.
For the Killer Aura reveal, another Survivor must lose a Health State due to the Killer.
duration: Killer Aura reveal: 6/8/10 seconds per qualifying event.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: The Killer Aura reveal now triggers only from Health State loss caused by the Killer; 8.3.0 had increased the reveal duration to 6/8/10 seconds and removed its 32 m condition.

perks.verification_notes: Current DBDVault survivor data and the wiki agree on the 6/8/10-second live values. The 10.1.2 notes contain no Survivor perk balance change.

perks.name: Inner Strength
perks.current_effect: After you cleanse a Totem, Inner Strength activates. While active, hide in a Locker for 10/9/8 seconds to heal yourself by one Health State. It deactivates after healing and cannot be used while you are Broken. Cleansing another Totem can activate it again.
perks.plain_english_summary: Cleansing a Totem lets you heal one Health State by hiding in a Locker for the tier's stated time.
activation_requirements: Cleanse a Totem; blessing a Totem does not activate the perk.
While activated, remain hidden inside a Locker for 10/9/8 seconds.
You must not be suffering from Broken when attempting to use it.
deactivation_conditions: Deactivates after healing one Health State.
duration: Locker channel required: 10/9/8 seconds.
special_interactions: Heals the user by one Health State, including Dying to Injured or Injured to Healthy.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.

perks.verification_notes: The perk was renamed Inner Healing while Stranger Things was unavailable and returned as Nancy Wheeler's Inner Strength when the chapter returned; those name/access changes are not a verified material effect balance change.

perks.name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
perks.current_effect: While in the Basement near the Invocation circle, press Activate Ability 2 to begin a 60-second ritual. Your Aura is revealed to all other Survivors during it. Other Survivors can join; each joining Survivor increases ritual speed by 100% if they have an Invocation perk equipped, or 50% otherwise. When completed, whenever the Killer scares a Crow while any Survivor is inside the Killer's Terror Radius, the Killer's Aura is revealed to all Survivors for 1/1.5/2 seconds. Completion puts you into the Injured State and applies Broken to you for the rest of the Trial, and disables other copies of this Invocation for all Survivors for the rest of the Trial.
perks.plain_english_summary: Complete a Basement ritual to reveal the Killer when they scare a Crow near a Survivor, at the cost of becoming Injured and Broken for the Trial.
activation_requirements: Be in the Basement near the Invocation circle and press Activate Ability 2.
Complete the 60-second ritual; teammates may join to increase its speed.
For the post-ritual Aura reveal, the Killer must scare a Crow while at least one Survivor is inside the Killer's Terror Radius.
deactivation_conditions: The invocation ability is disabled for all Survivors after one completion for the remainder of the Trial.
The Broken Status Effect on the invoker lasts for the remainder of the Trial.
duration: Ritual: 60 seconds before helper speed modifiers.
Killer Aura reveal: 1/1.5/2 seconds per qualifying Crow event.
Broken: remainder of the Trial.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Each Invocation: Treacherous Crows can be completed once per Trial across all Survivors; completion disables other copies of this Invocation.
special_interactions: During an Invocation, teammates can join and speed it up; those with any Invocation perk contribute +100% speed, while those without contribute +50%.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.

perks.verification_notes: 8.4.0 introduced the perk. Later standardized wording changes do not materially change its live effect. Status-effect list audit: Health States/conditions and effects caused only by a generic Endurance interaction were removed; only actual Status Effects applied or directly involved are listed.

perks.name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
perks.current_effect: While in the Basement near the Invocation circle, press Activate Ability 2 to begin a 60-second ritual. Your Aura is revealed to all other Survivors during it. Other Survivors can join; each joining Survivor increases ritual speed by 100% if they have an Invocation perk equipped, or 50% otherwise. When completed, permanently reduce the repair-charge requirement of every Generator in the Trial by 8/9/10 charges. The invoker enters the Injured State and suffers Broken for the remainder of the Trial. If everyone stops participating, unfinished ritual progress regresses; the live 8.0.0 change made full regression take 90 seconds. Completion disables other copies of this Invocation for the Trial.
perks.plain_english_summary: A Basement ritual permanently lowers every Generator's repair requirement, while leaving the invoker Injured and Broken for the Trial.
activation_requirements: Be in the Basement near the Invocation circle and press Activate Ability 2.
Complete the 60-second ritual; teammates may join to increase its speed.
deactivation_conditions: If no Survivor continues the ritual, its progress regresses back to zero.
The Broken Status Effect on the invoker lasts for the remainder of the Trial.
duration: Ritual: 60 seconds before helper speed modifiers.
Interrupted ritual progress takes 90 seconds to fully regress under the live regression rule.
Generator repair requirement reduction and Broken: permanent for the remainder of the Trial.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: This Invocation can be completed once per Trial across all Survivors; completion disables other copies of Invocation: Weaving Spiders.
special_interactions: During an Invocation, teammates can join and speed it up; those with any Invocation perk contribute +100% speed, while those without contribute +50%.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced ritual completion time from 120 to 60 seconds and slowed full regression of interrupted progress from 6 to 90 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: The current charge-reduction mechanic and shared Invocation rules were checked against current reference pages; 8.4.0's description standardization was not treated as a balance change. Status-effect list audit: Health States/conditions and effects caused only by a generic Endurance interaction were removed; only actual Status Effects applied or directly involved are listed.

perks.name: Iron Will
perks.current_effect: While Injured, reduce the volume of your Grunts of Pain by 80/90/100%. Iron Will does not function while you are Exhausted, but it does not itself inflict Exhausted.
perks.plain_english_summary: While Injured and not Exhausted, it greatly reduces the volume of your Grunts of Pain.
activation_requirements: Be in the Injured State.
Not be suffering from Exhausted.
deactivation_conditions: The effect stops when you are no longer Injured or become Exhausted.
duration: No fixed duration; applies while the activation conditions are met.
status_effects_involved: Exhausted (prevents effect; Iron Will does not inflict it)

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased Grunts of Pain volume reduction from 25/50/75% to 80/90/100%.

perks.verification_notes: DBDVault showed a stale 10.1.1 page header during research; its listed value is corroborated by BHVR's 8.1.0 live notes, and the 10.1.2 live notes contain no Survivor perk balance change.

perks.name: Kindred
perks.current_effect: Whenever any Survivor is hooked, Kindred activates. All Survivors see the Killer's Aura while the Killer is within 8/12/16 m of the Hook. If you are hooked, all other Survivors see each other's Auras; if another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of all other Survivors. These effects last while a Survivor remains hooked.
perks.plain_english_summary: During any hook, it reveals nearby Killer Aura to everyone and shares Survivor Auras according to whether you are hooked.
activation_requirements: Any Survivor is hooked.
deactivation_conditions: The effect ends when no Survivor remains hooked.
duration: While a Survivor is hooked.
special_interactions: When the perk owner is hooked, the other Survivors see one another's Auras; when another Survivor is hooked, the perk owner sees all other Survivors' Auras.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added the effect that lets the perk owner see the Auras of other Survivors when another Survivor is hooked.

upcoming_or_ptb_changes.change: Proposed changing the Killer Aura reveal range to 14/15/16 m from the current live 8/12/16 m, both when you are hooked and when another Survivor is hooked. These PTB values are not live as of 2026-10-05.

perks.verification_notes: The wiki's Kindred page marks the proposed 10.2.0 PTB range in its current description; current live range is taken from DBDVault and the prior live description, with the PTB values kept separately above.

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.current_effect: After you spend 120/105/90 seconds in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in a Chase, Last Stand activates. While active, a Rushed Vault stuns the Killer for 3 seconds if they are within 2.5 m of the vault location. After the perk triggers, it is disabled for the remainder of the Trial.
perks.plain_english_summary: Time spent in the Terror Radius outside Chase charges a one-use stun that can trigger on a close Rushed Vault.
activation_requirements: Accumulate 120/105/90 seconds in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in a Chase.
While active, perform a Rushed Vault with the Killer within 2.5 m of the vault location.
deactivation_conditions: After its stun triggers, the perk is disabled for the remainder of the Trial.
duration: Killer stun: 3 seconds.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Once the effect triggers, it cannot be used again for the remainder of the Trial.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Introduced live with a 120/105/90-second Terror Radius charge requirement and a 3-second stun; the launch values were higher than the preceding PTB proposal.

perks.verification_notes: The 9.1.0 PTB proposed 80/70/60 seconds, but live 9.1.0 notes specify 120/105/90; the PTB values are not used here.

perks.name: Leader
perks.current_effect: All other Survivors within 10 m of you gain 20/25/30% action speed for Cleansing, Gate-Opening, Healing, Sabotaging, Unhooking, and Unlocking. The effect lingers for 15 seconds after leaving the radius. A Survivor can be affected by only one instance of Leader at a time; the perk owner does not benefit from their own Leader.
perks.plain_english_summary: Nearby teammates gain faster listed actions, with the bonus lingering briefly after they leave your radius.
activation_requirements: Another Survivor must be within 10 m of you to receive the action-speed bonus.
deactivation_conditions: For each affected Survivor, the bonus ends 15 seconds after leaving the 10 m radius.
duration: Linger after leaving range: 15 seconds.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Each Survivor can benefit from only one instance of Leader at a time.
special_interactions: The perk affects other Survivors, not its owner.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Raised the action-speed bonus to 20/25/30% from 15/20/25% and increased the radius to 10 m from 8 m.

perks.verification_notes: DBDVault's page header was stale at 10.1.1 in one retrieval; its live effect is corroborated by BHVR's 9.2.0 note and current wiki. The 10.1.2 notes contain no Survivor perk balance change.

perks.name: Left Behind
perks.current_effect: When you are the last Survivor remaining in the Trial, the Hatch's Aura is revealed to you within 24/28/32 m.
perks.plain_english_summary: As the last Survivor remaining, you can see the Hatch's Aura within the tier's range.
activation_requirements: Be the last Survivor remaining in the Trial.
deactivation_conditions: The effect ends when the Trial ends or you are no longer the last Survivor remaining.
duration: While you are the last Survivor remaining; Aura reveal is range-limited.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reworked the perk to reveal the Hatch's Aura within 24/28/32 m when you are the last Survivor alive.

perks.verification_notes: The live 3.2.0 patch reworked Left Behind to its Hatch Aura effect; current DBDVault data shows 24/28/32 m.

perks.name: Lend a Hand
perks.current_effect: After you bless or cleanse 1 Totem, while healing another Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give that Survivor 2/3/4 permanent healing charges. The effect can be used multiple times in one Trial if you fulfill the Totem condition again, but only once per recipient.
perks.plain_english_summary: After a Totem interaction, you can add permanent healing charges to a teammate while healing them.
activation_requirements: Bless or cleanse 1 Totem to fulfill the activation condition.
While healing another Survivor, press Activate Ability 2.
deactivation_conditions: The effect cannot be applied to the same recipient more than once by this perk user.
duration: Healing charges given to the recipient are permanent.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Can be used multiple times per Trial after meeting the Totem condition again; only once per other Survivor.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Changed from once per match to reusable multiple times when the Totem condition is fulfilled again, while retaining a once-per-recipient limit.

perks.verification_notes: DBDVault's page says 'once per Trial and per Survivor,' which conflicts with the official 10.0.1 live notes. Current live use is repeatable after meeting the Totem condition again, once per recipient; the DBDVault limit is stale/inaccurate.

perks.name: Light-Footed
perks.current_effect: While Healthy, suppresses the sound of your footsteps while running. After you perform a Rushed Vault, the perk has a 14/12/10-second cooldown.
perks.plain_english_summary: While Healthy and off cooldown, it silences your running footsteps.
activation_requirements: Be Healthy.
Not be in the cooldown following a Rushed Vault.
deactivation_conditions: Becoming Injured ends the effect; performing a Rushed Vault starts the tier-specific cooldown.
perks.cooldown: 14/12/10 seconds after a Rushed Vault (Tier I/II/III).
duration: No fixed active duration; effect applies while Healthy and off cooldown.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced cooldown after a Rushed Vault from 28/24/20 to 14/12/10 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: DBDVault's page header was stale at 10.1.1 in one retrieval; the live effect and 9.0.0 cooldown are also supported by the Survivor page and BHVR patch notes.

perks.name: Lightweight
perks.current_effect: Reduces the lifetime of your Scratch Marks by 3/4/5 seconds. It also reduces the spawn chance of patches of Scratch Marks by 60%, making their spacing inconsistent.
perks.plain_english_summary: Your Scratch Marks disappear sooner and spawn in less consistent patches.
duration: Applies to Scratch Marks whenever they are created; lifetime reduction is 3/4/5 seconds by tier.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Increased Scratch Mark lifetime reduction from 1/2/3 to 3/4/5 seconds and added a 60% patch-spawn chance reduction effect.

perks.verification_notes: The current documented perk effect remains 3/4/5 seconds plus 60% fewer Scratch Mark patches. BHVR's 8.6.0 live notes later changed general Scratch Mark spawn logic but do not describe a Lightweight-specific value change; forum users have reported a possible interaction with that change, so the actual patch-spacing behavior is not independently confirmed here.

perks.name: Lithe
perks.current_effect: Whenever you perform a Rushed Vault action while not Exhausted, gain 50% Haste for 3 seconds. Lithe cannot be used while Exhausted and causes Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds by tier.
perks.plain_english_summary: A Rushed Vault grants a brief speed boost and then Exhausted prevents reuse until it expires.
activation_requirements: Perform a Rushed Vault action.
Not be suffering from Exhausted.
deactivation_conditions: The Haste effect ends after 3 seconds; Exhausted prevents triggering Lithe again until it expires.
perks.cooldown: Exhausted lasts 60/50/40 seconds (Tier I/II/III); there is no separate cooldown.
duration: Haste: 3 seconds.
Exhausted: 60/50/40 seconds by tier.
special_interactions: The activation requires a Rushed Vault; it does not require being in a Chase.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Removed the Chase requirement; Lithe now triggers only on Rushed Vaults.

perks.verification_notes: Live values are 50% for 3 seconds and Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds; no 10.2.0 PTB change applies to Lithe.

perks.name: Low Profile
perks.current_effect: Whenever you are the only Survivor in the Trial not currently incapacitated by being downed, carried, or hooked, Low Profile activates. For 70/80/90 seconds it suppresses your Grunts of Pain and the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks. It deactivates after use, counts only Survivors still participating in the Trial, and can activate multiple times if its condition is met again.
perks.plain_english_summary: When you are the only active Survivor still in the Trial, it hides your pain sounds and tracking traces for a tier-based duration.
activation_requirements: Be the only Survivor still participating in the Trial who is not downed, carried, or hooked.
deactivation_conditions: The activation ends after 70/80/90 seconds; the perk may activate again if its condition is met later in the Trial.
duration: Suppression effect: 70/80/90 seconds by tier.
perks.once_per_trial_or_other_limits: Not limited to one use per Trial; it can activate more than once when the condition is met again.
special_interactions: Survivors who have left the Trial are not counted toward its activation condition.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: The live activation condition was broadened from last Survivor standing to being the only Survivor not incapacitated, enabling multiple activations in a Trial.

perks.verification_notes: The 6.2.0 PTB/live patch text retains the original 'last Survivor standing' wording, while current wiki and DBDVault data document the broadened live activation rule and multiple activations. Current mechanics follow the latter; the 6.2.0 live note also added Grunts of Pain suppression.

perks.name: Lucky Break
perks.current_effect: Whenever you are Injured, Lucky Break activates and suppresses the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks for up to 40/50/60 seconds. While healing another Survivor, it recharges by the time spent healing, up to its initial maximum. It deactivates when its timer runs out or when your Health State changes to anything other than Injured.
perks.plain_english_summary: While Injured, it hides Blood Pools and Scratch Marks for a limited timer that you can refill by healing someone else.
activation_requirements: Be in the Injured State.
deactivation_conditions: The effect ends when its timer runs out or when your Health State changes to anything other than Injured.
duration: Suppression timer: up to 40/50/60 seconds by tier; time spent healing another Survivor restores the timer one-for-one up to its initial maximum.
special_interactions: Healing another Survivor recharges the timer by the same amount of time spent healing, capped at the perk's initial duration.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Added one second of timer recharge for every second spent healing another Survivor, up to the initial duration.

perks.verification_notes: Current live effect matches current DBDVault and wiki descriptions; the latest material change found is the 6.1.0 recharge mechanic.

perks.name: Lucky Star
perks.current_effect: While hiding inside a Locker, suppresses your Grunts of Pain for as long as you remain inside. After exiting the Locker, for 30 seconds it suppresses your Grunts of Pain and creation of Pools of Blood, reveals all other Survivors' Auras to you, and reveals the nearest Generator's Aura to you in yellow. It then has a 35/30/25-second cooldown.
perks.plain_english_summary: Hiding in a Locker silences your pain sounds, and exiting gives 30 seconds of stealth and Aura information before cooldown.
activation_requirements: Hide inside a Locker.
deactivation_conditions: The inside-Locker effect ends when you exit.
The post-exit effects end after 30 seconds; cooldown prevents reactivation.
perks.cooldown: 35/30/25 seconds after the post-exit effect (Tier I/II/III).
duration: While in Locker: suppresses Grunts of Pain for the time you remain inside.
After exiting: suppression and Aura effects last 30 seconds.
special_interactions: After exiting, the perk reveals every other Survivor and the nearest Generator; the Generator Aura is yellow.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Reduced cooldown from 40/35/30 to 35/30/25 seconds.

perks.verification_notes: 9.2.0 cooldown is the latest material change. The cooldown timing after the 30-second post-exit effect follows current reference history; BHVR's 9.2.0 notes confirm the cooldown values.

perks.name: Made for This
perks.current_effect: Activates while you are in the Injured State. While active, completing a Healing action on another Survivor grants Endurance for the tier duration; that Endurance ends early if you perform any Conspicuous Action. While active and suffering from Deep Wound, running grants the tier-specific Haste bonus.
perks.plain_english_summary: While injured, healing a teammate grants temporary Endurance, and running while Deep Wounded grants tier-scaled Haste.
activation_requirements: Be in the Injured State.
Complete a Healing action on another Survivor to trigger Endurance.
Be suffering from Deep Wound and running to receive Haste.
deactivation_conditions: The Endurance effect ends after its tier duration or early when you perform a Conspicuous Action.
The Haste effect applies only while running and suffering from Deep Wound; the perk otherwise remains available while injured.
duration: Endurance: 6/8/10 seconds.
Haste: while running and suffering from Deep Wound; no separate duration is specified.
special_interactions: The Haste effect applies only to running, not other movement modes.

latest_known_live_balance_change.change: Haste now requires Deep Wound and applies while running; Exhausted no longer disables the perk.

perks.verification_notes: Live values use the current DBDVault effect and the shipped 7.4.0 change; 10.1.2a has no Survivor perk balance change. Status-effect list audit: Health States/conditions and effects caused only by a generic Endurance interaction were removed; only actual Status Effects applied or directly involved are listed.

perks.name: Mettle of Man
perks.current_effect: After you trigger a third Protection Hit by any means, the perk activates. While Injured, it shields you from the next attack that would put you into the Dying State. After you heal to full health by any means, the Killer sees your Aura whenever you are farther than the tier-specific distance from them. The perk deactivates when you enter the Dying State by any means. It increases your chance to be the initial Obsession by +100%; a Killer can have only one Obsession at a time.
perks.plain_english_summary: After three Protection Hits, it can prevent one hit from downing you and later reveals your Aura to the Killer at long range.
activation_requirements: Trigger a third Protection Hit by any means.
Be Injured for the protective shield to apply.
Heal to full health for the Killer-aura reveal component to apply.
